definition: quiet, relaxed and not worried at all
description: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.
